nazwa: Wydział Nauk Ścisłych i Przyrodniczych, Uniwersytet Szczeciński
nazwa_en: Faculty of Exact and Natural Sciences, University of Szczecin
opis: Profil importów WNSiP (v50). Szkice planów robi parser plan-bm (scripts/us/wnsip-pdf.mjs) i wysyła je do kolejki nauka_import_szkic_automat; ten sam profil działa dla PDF-u wgranego ręcznie (szkic AI).

plan.polecenie:
Each item is ONE class in the weekly timetable of one year of study. Day columns Poniedziałek … Piątek (sometimes split into group columns), time rows "8.15-9.00" on the left; d = weekday: 0 Monday … 4 Friday.
od/do = the time written in the cell ("08:15-09:45") or the rows the cell covers.
pl = course name; kind and hours are in brackets: "[w/30h]" lecture, "[k/15h]" konwersatorium, "[lab/36h]", "[lektorat/30h]".
pg = "gr:<n>" when the cell says "gr. n", else "".
r = room as printed; letters after the number are buildings: W = ul. Wąska 13, F = ul. Felczaka 3c.
grupa = the year group code given in the task (e.g. SOC1); tydzien = oba.
k = W (wykład, lecture), CW (ćwiczenia, exercises, lektorat, warsztaty), K (konwersatorium), S (seminarium), LAB (laboratorium), X (other).
p = teachers as printed; daty = dates as YYYY-MM-DD (October–December 2026, January–February 2027), [] when the class is every week.
en = "", g = "", n = notes (exceptions such as "ostatnie zajęcia w godz. …") or "".

przyklady.n: zajęcia dn. 24.XI trwają 1 godz. w godzinach 8.15 - 9.00
